title: float map keys: lookup with else, plain lookup and has, literal and variable keys, -0.0, subnormal and huge keys
purpose: Observe float-keyed lookups with a fallback on every engine (#301: the Sparrow JIT passed the key as f64).

provenance.origin: authored for #301 from the spec text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 8.8: float is a key type; float keys compare numerically, so -0.0 and 0.0 are one key; a present key's else fallback is not evaluated (the fallback panics), a missing key's is.
